name: Yes No API
tagline: Simple yes/no/maybe answers with animated GIFs
description: Free public API that returns a random yes, no, or maybe answer along with a matching animated GIF. No authentication required. Useful for playful decision UIs, demos, and novelty integrations.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public unauthenticated HTTP GET.

use_cases: get a random yes/no/maybe answer with a GIF
force a yes answer for demos
force a no answer for demos
fetch novelty GIF responses for chatbots
